test_feather_round_trip: test the to_feather and read_feather functions round-trip a DataFrame with mixed column types
test_feather_read_columns: test read_feather with a columns parameter to read only specified columns from a feather file
test_feather_dtype_backend: test read_feather with dtype_backend parameter to convert nullable types for pyarrow or numpy_nullable backends
test_feather_error_non_dataframe: test to_feather raises ValueError when given non-DataFrame objects like Series, int, or string
test_feather_duplicate_columns: test to_feather raises an error when writing a DataFrame with duplicate column names
